title: Motion Verbs — iść vs. jechać
title_fa: افعال حرکتی — iść در برابر jechać
grammarPoint: iść (go on foot, now) vs. jechać (go by vehicle); present tense forms; chodzić vs. jeździć (habitual)
grammarPoint_fa: iść (پیاده رفتن) در برابر jechać (با وسیله نقلیه رفتن)

explanation.text:
Polish has two main verbs for 'to go' depending on how you travel:

| Verb | Meaning | When to use |
|------|---------|-------------|
| **iść** | to go (on foot, right now) | 'I'm walking to the shop' |
| **jechać** | to go (by vehicle, right now) | 'I'm driving/taking the bus' |
| **chodzić** | to go (on foot, habitually) | 'I walk to work every day' |
| **jeździć** | to go (by vehicle, habitually) | 'I take the train every week' |

**Present tense of iść:**

| Person | Form |
|--------|------|
| ja | **idę** |
| ty | **idziesz** |
| on/ona | **idzie** |
| my | **idziemy** |
| wy | **idziecie** |
| oni/one | **idą** |

**Present tense of jechać:**

| Person | Form |
|--------|------|
| ja | **jadę** |
| ty | **jedziesz** |
| on/ona | **jedzie** |
| my | **jedziemy** |
| wy | **jedziecie** |
| oni/one | **jadą** |

**Examples:**
- Idę do sklepu. = I'm going to the shop (on foot, now).
- Jadę do Warszawy autobusem. = I'm going to Warsaw by bus.
- Chodzę do pracy pieszo. = I walk to work (every day).
- Jeżdżę do szkoły rowerem. = I cycle to school (regularly).
notes: iść/jechać = current motion (happening now); chodzić/jeździć = habitual/repeated motion.
Transport in instrumental: jadę autobusem (by bus), jadę rowerem (by bike), jadę samochodem (by car).
Pieszo = on foot (adverb). Idę pieszo = I go on foot.
Do + genitive for destination: Jadę do Krakowa. Idę do domu.

explanation_fa: iść برای رفتن پیاده و jechać برای رفتن با وسیله نقلیه (ماشین، اتوبوس و ...) استفاده می‌شود. اشکال iść: idę، idziesz، idzie، idziemy، idziecie، idą. اشکال jechać: jadę، jedziesz، jedzie، jedziemy، jedziecie، jadą.

exercises.prompt: Choose the right verb: ___ do sklepu. (I'm walking to the shop right now.)
exercises.explanation: 'Idę do sklepu' = I'm going to the shop (on foot, right now). 'Iść' = motion on foot happening now.

exercises.prompt: Ona ___ do Warszawy pociągiem. (She is going to Warsaw by train, right now.) [jechać, ona]

exercises.explanation: You heard: 'Jeżdżę do pracy samochodem.' — I drive to work (habitually). 'Jeździć' = go by vehicle habitually. 'Samochodem' = by car (instrumental).

exercises.prompt: Build: We are going to Kraków by train.
exercises.explanation: 'Jedziemy do Krakowa pociągiem' = We're going to Kraków by train. 'Jechać' → jedziemy (by vehicle). 'Do + genitive': Kraków → Krakowa.

exercises.prompt: Every day I cycle to school. Which is correct?
exercises.explanation: 'Jeżdżę do szkoły rowerem' = I cycle to school (habitual). 'Jeździć' for repeated vehicle motion. 'Rowerem' = by bicycle (instrumental).
